name: 40-second standstill timeout v13
authorization: User requested extending the timeout to40seconds on all maps and policies. Change the native standstill rule and UI. Four prior heavy-jam timeouts rerun once from initial seed;26 completed recordings retained with independent40second compatibility reconstruction.

stopping_rule.definition: At reset anchor=ego position, last_movement_step=0. At each physics tick, displacement strictly greater than 0.5m resets anchor and last_movement_step. Timeout when 600 ticks have elapsed since the most recent movement-anchor reset. Collision, off-route and completion take precedence. Applies to queues as well as avoidable stops. Simulation seconds, not wall time.

limits: Exploratory demonstrations on already observed scenarios, one model seed. Longer waiting does not guarantee completion. Existing models, assist, traffic and maps unchanged from latest versions.
npc_guard: Continuous oriented-rectangle translation test with conservative rotation envelope and 0.2 m clearance, plus native one-tick collision forecast. Rejected steps are kinematic holds. Unlike the prior circular guard, safe adjacent lanes can pass. Ego unshielded; real queues may still stop.
finish: Finite lane-width finish segment touching ego body after all turns. Evaluated every physics tick on all maps/policies. Collision/off-route take precedence.
npc_forward_only: Both queue and crossing NPC subclasses clamp speed to >=0 before and after each native physics tick. Native positions, steering and impact handling retained. No change to ego speed/action or saved policies.
reuse: 26 successful prior recordings kept unchanged after40second compatibility audit;4 prior heavy-jam timeouts rerun from start. No continuation, resume or padded frozen frames.
npc_junctions: City NPCs now share FIFO crossing reservations. Four NPC lane crossing points 16 m apart merge into each of thirty 26 m square conflict boxes. NPCs wait before entry, require downstream space, and release after passage. Spawn inside boxes is rejected. Existing jam coordinator unchanged; highway unchanged. This kinematic traffic coordination is separate from learned ego control.
observation_correction: For the ego on every map, retain existing distance limit and rear filter but rank eligible actors by Euclidean distance before selecting 14. Kinematics and action forecasts use the identical selector. This deliberately changes input ordering for fixed saved weights; this is a labelled transfer demonstration, not unchanged scientific evaluation.
spawn_timing: Scheduled traffic admission and removal happen after physics and before the next returned observation. No actors may appear between a recorded observation and its chosen action. Bare Gym observation and wrappers all reflect the updated scene.
unchanged_control: Saved model weights/formulas unchanged; separate labelled memory assist may override speed actions using recorded forecasts and known route turn distance. Steering remains route controller.
intersection_change: No geometry or traffic changes from v12. Only standstill deadline20->40seconds.

assist.name: Progress Assist v1
assist.scope: All five policies, explicitly labelled assisted
assist.rule: Fastest positive target under cap with predicted clearance/horizon, latch after1s of clear forecasts, reconsider every0.2s; retain model until latch, block nonpositive selected forecasts, cap turn target. No claim of safety.
